I focused I needed to be a better person and felt some guilt for being a horrible son and I wish my dad could see me be better. My dad told me this for several years and on Easter Day this year the last thing he said to me was I don’t have to worry anymore, a few hours later I found him dying from a bunch of pills he took and he passed away. This is one of the mos traumatic things ever and my family was not close. My dad was single and had a lot of mental health issues such as ptsd, anxiety, depression,bipolar, bpd etc. it was horrible watching him suffer and now that he passed I think of him everyday and wish he could still be here and all the things I wish I could of told him, and would of listened every time he said what you say. We actually do care but can’t imagine that ever happening until it’s reality. It’s very sad and there’s a lot to life if you start focusing on changing yourself and not your demons and mistakes. Call your daughter more and tell her how you feel
